concept: What happens when only the credit card minimum due is paid?
original_upload_name: ElevenLabs_2026-10-04T08_44_59_Bunty - Punchy, Crisp and Reel King_pvc_sp100_s50_sb75_v4(1).mp3

voice.filename_description: Bunty - Punchy, Crisp and Reel King, v4

timing_method: large-v3-turbo Telugu ASR phrase/word cues, with sentence onsets adjusted against original decoded-audio silence gaps; first-pass editing cues, not human-verified forced alignment
caption_status: Draft: English words and Telugu spellings normalised; compare wording and timestamps with audio before publishing captions

scenes.name: The payment worked. Why interest?
scenes.action: Open inside the problem: a realistic paper finance-charge line beside the earlier minimum-payment receipt. Rack focus from Interest charged to Payment received. A fingertip stops beside the interest line. No payment-success-only opening.

scenes.name: Only the minimum was paid
scenes.action: Reveal the original statement: total bill ₹50,000; stated minimum ₹1,000. Put the received ₹1,000 payment receipt beside it. The receipt stays green and successful; the full bill remains unpaid.

scenes.name: The purchase-date reveal
scenes.action: Match-cut the same card into its original retail purchase. A fresh receipt shows 7 May. Show the calendar date, then start a thin yellow tracked mark from 7 May on the spoken నుంచే. The highlight belongs on the physical calendar or receipt, not a floating slide.

scenes.name: Balance before payment
scenes.action: Travel through the same physical calendar from 7 May toward 1 June. Keep the illustrative original ₹50,000 balance visible while the voice describes the amount outstanding before payment.

scenes.name: Balance after payment
scenes.action: At the 1 June marker, slide the received ₹1,000 receipt into place. Reveal ₹49,000 before interest/other additions as the narration says మిగిలిన బాకీ. Continue the time highlight beyond payment against this reduced balance.

scenes.name: Late fee and interest are different
scenes.action: Two macro inserts on the statement: Late payment charge ₹0, then Finance charges / Interest charged. Move focus to the second line on కానీ interest ఆగదు. A subtle amber highlight is enough; avoid a fake computed interest total.

scenes.name: A new purchase has its own date
scenes.action: The earlier unpaid statement remains on the desk. Match-cut to a new small-shop card-terminal purchase using the same card. The new receipt is dated 4 June. Begin its separate interest-date highlight at 4 June, rather than reusing 7 May.

scenes.name: The practical question
scenes.action: Return to the home desk. Place the card beside the unpaid statement; a hand pauses over a notebook, then reaches for the phone. Keep one live focus move while the voice asks how to break the cycle.

scenes.name: Full-video invitation
scenes.action: Show a fresh phone composition with a newly made full-Telugu-video cover. Display Full Telugu video ↓ with small BE PRACTICAL branding. Keep the frame alive through a slow push and hold the ending. The genuine clickable Related Video is supplied by YouTube, outside the burned-in graphic.

key_cues.action: Start the original interest-date mark at 7 May.
Bring the 1 June received-payment receipt into the shot.
Hold the Late payment charge ₹0 line.
Rack focus to the finance-charge line.
Reveal the new receipt, dated 4 June.
Start the new purchase's own interest-date mark at 4 June.
